s: What is India's ranking in the Global Peace Index-2014, published by Institute of Economics and Peace?
x: The 'Global Peace Index' is an attempt to measure the relative status of peace in various nations and regions. It is released annually since May 2007 based on data from the 'Economist Intelligence Unit', based in London, England, by the Sydney based Institute for Economics & Peace. The GPI was released on June 18th, 2014 (8th edition) covering 162 countries with 22 indicators. With 1.189 points, Iceland remains the world's most peaceful country for the seventh consecutive year. In this list, India with 2.571 score was ranked 143rd. According to Global Peace Index, 2022 Iceland remains the most peaceful country in the world, a position it has held since 2008. Iceland is followed by New Zealand, Ireland, Denmark and Austria. Seven of the ten countries at the top of the GPI are in Europe. India ranked 115th out of 163 countries in the Global Peace Index 2025.
